independence_declaration.statement: I am domain-reviewer. I authored nothing in the reviewed scope: the sources, analysis, register, agent definitions, gate or agent tooling, and delivery docs. My only writes are my round-22 review record, my findings sidecar and my own evidence under docs/delivery/test-evidence/DG0/domain/round-22/. I formed this verdict without reading any other round-22 review record. The only earlier review material I read was my own round-21 domain record and evidence, to reuse my own check scripts.
